name: ring-control
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; echo MODE=compiled; set +e; GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 taskset -c 0-3 timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/protocols/run.ts --only ring_leader_election --skip given,broken --ms 60000; echo EXIT=$?; set -e; TRACK_GEN_DISPOSABLE=1 bun research/track-gen/disable-fast-experiment.ts; echo MODE=interpreted; set +e; GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 taskset -c 0-3 timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/protocols/run.ts --only ring_leader_election --skip given,broken --ms 60000; echo EXIT=$?
